item.title: Version 1.0.14-dev.4
item.sparkle:releaseNotes:
• release: windows v1.0.14-dev.4
  • fix(idle): save threshold on blur, actual elapsed time, Flutter task selector
  • docs: add session 2 handoff context for idle detection branch
  • Merge branch 'dev' of github.com:vavilov2212/worklog_studio into dev
  • fix(idle): entry identity guard, accumulator reset, window lifecycle, unquoted exe path
  • docs: add worklog journal entries for Tasks 5-8 idle detection
  • feat: add idle threshold and launch-at-startup settings UI
  • fix(idle): clear activity window visibility on native accept path and fix hider callback ordering
  • fix: remove idleMonitor param from TimeTrackerBloc construction in app.dart
  • feat: wire IdleFlowCubit into app lifecycle, remove idle from TimeTrackerBloc
  • fix(idle): start IdleMonitor immediately if bloc already running at cubit construction
  • feat: add IdleFlowCubit orchestration
  • feat: add IdleResolutionWindow native Win32 popup
  • feat: add NativeWindowCoordinator for idle/activity window mutual exclusion
  • fix: add win32 prefix to wsalloc calls in WindowsStartupService
  • feat: add StartupService with Windows registry auto-start
  • feat: add WindowsIdleMonitor with sleep-drift detection
  • fix: add const keyword to UserReturnedFromIdle constructor
  • feat: extend domain for idle detection (stop(endAt:), UserReturnedFromIdle, settings keys)
  • docs: idle detection implementation plan
  • docs: idle detection and Windows auto-start design spec
